title: Apollo Lunar Module LM-5 · Eagle, on the Moon

subject.summary: LM-5 Eagle as she stood at Tranquility Base: the octagonal descent stage under its gold and black thermal blankets, four splayed legs with footpads and sensing probes, and the faceted ascent stage with its triangular windows, forward hatch and porch, docking tunnel, RCS quads and antennas.

ascent stage: push the four RCS quads onto the upper shoulders and crown the roof with the real hipped profile
roof and porch: add the ECS radiator, the SEQ bay interior and the MESA pallet so no face is bare up close
